description: This file defines the PdfNull class, representing a null or 'indirect reference' object in the PDF structure, with methods for string representation and serialization.

classes.name: PdfNull
classes.description: Represents a null object in PDF, inheriting from PdfItem, with singleton pattern implementation for its instance.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string 'null' to represent the null object.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the PdfNull instance by writing raw ' null ' to the PDF stream using the provided PdfWriter.
